policy_areas.name: route/auth/source-send approval

policy_areas.name: packet budgets
policy_areas.implementation: Direct API reviewers and Grok enforce prompt caps before launch. Claude subscription custom-review has a reproduced full-source packet budget gap tracked by #173; #172 remains the broader large-packet routing and chunking follow-up.
policy_areas.missing_guardrail: #173 tracks the reproduced Claude subscription custom-review budget gate; #172 tracks broader large review packet failures and provider-specific capacity policy.

policy_areas.name: fallback semantics
policy_areas.implementation: Grok defaults to CLI, explicit web remains explicit, and auto may fall back only from approved CLI readiness/login/model failures to the local web tunnel.

policy_areas.name: failure taxonomy
policy_areas.implementation: Shared classification maps runtime/provider failures to normalized external-model failure classes and suggested diagnostics.

policy_areas.name: suggested actions
policy_areas.implementation: Shared failure diagnostics provide provider-neutral suggested_action text, with Grok-specific text preserving no paid API fallback.

policy_areas.name: audit fields
policy_areas.implementation: Review audit manifests record selected route, fallback reason, auth path, billing path, source approval state, source bearing, source transmission, and review-quality fields.

policy_areas.name: review-quality gates
policy_areas.implementation: Shared helper reports failed review slots and semantic failure reasons across direct API and Grok outputs.

policy_areas.name: status/UX normalization
policy_areas.interface: lifecycle markdown cards, review panel records, error envelope fields
policy_areas.implementation: Shared lifecycle and panel rendering contracts normalize provider, job, route, auth, billing, source, status, error, and suggested action fields.
policy_areas.sync_guard: npm run lint:sync runs sync-companion-common.mjs --check and sync-review-panel.mjs --check

policy_areas.name: generated contracts
policy_areas.implementation: Provider command and skill docs are generated from one shared source and checked for staleness.

policy_areas.name: docs
policy_areas.implementation: Docs define #171 scope, use #170 as evidence only, and preserve no paid Grok API fallback language.

policy_areas.name: packaged copies
policy_areas.implementation: Packaged plugin copies remain byte-identical to canonical shared sources for libraries used by providers.

policy_areas.name: sync rules
policy_areas.implementation: Sync check scripts fail CI when generated docs or packaged shared library copies drift.

exceptions.current_behavior: Grok has two subscription transports. Default CLI remains terminal; explicit auto is the only mode allowed to fall back from approved CLI readiness/login/model failures to the local web tunnel.
exceptions.reason: Grok lacks a direct shared companion API route and #159 established CLI-primary with audited local web fallback, never paid xAI API fallback.

guardrail_tests.name: provider parity table contract
guardrail_tests.purpose: Fail when the canonical provider parity table is missing required providers, policy areas, issue fit, evidence, or schema shape.
guardrail_tests.red_condition: provider-parity-table.json is missing or omits a required FR-002 policy area.
guardrail_tests.green_condition: provider-parity-table.json parses and satisfies the checked schema/policy inventory.

guardrail_tests.name: shared audit/status field inventory
guardrail_tests.purpose: Fail when generated provider-neutral contracts stop naming shared audit/status fields.
guardrail_tests.red_condition: renderExternalModelContractDoc omits a shared audit/status field.
guardrail_tests.green_condition: Generated contract docs contain the complete shared field inventory.

guardrail_tests.name: shared policy interface usage
guardrail_tests.purpose: Fail when provider-facing entrypoints or synced libs stop consuming required shared policy interfaces.
guardrail_tests.red_condition: A required shared interface is absent from provider-facing source or the parity table.
guardrail_tests.green_condition: The interface inventory is explicit and each required interface is present in provider-facing source.

guardrail_tests.name: grok auto transport fallback
guardrail_tests.purpose: Fail when Grok auto transport stops preserving CLI default, audited local web fallback, or no-paid-API guarantees.
guardrail_tests.red_condition: GROK_TRANSPORT=auto is rejected, falls back to paid API credentials, or fails to record CLI-to-web fallback metadata.
guardrail_tests.green_condition: Auto mode records CLI success as CLI and approved CLI failure fallback as local web with source disclosure.
